detail: Full summary: seven live defects existed in the Stage 0 slice and were fixed by lane 02b, the worst being that project() re-read events from disk so a sparse checkout or reset --hard silently dropped admitted records at the next projection (C14 Arm B had passed only because it never re-projected). Journal now caches exact envelope bytes (events.db schema v2). Others: carriers swallowed malformed artifacts; dedup trusted a self-declared digest; cycle detection was per-pass and supersession-only; an imported human principal could mint a ruling signer (C12); nothing bound the signing key to the asserted producer; the deferral trail went stale.
